facts.fact: Augentic signed a 15-year Build-Operate-Transfer contract with the DGSN on 13 May 2024 to produce and operate the new biometric national ID card system, with equipment and infrastructure to be handed over to the Cameroonian government once the 'Operate' component ends, according to Biometric Update.

facts.fact: Cameroon's DGSN contracted Augentic on 13 May 2024 to build a new generation biometric national ID card system, with 68 new structures, three production centres and 219 renovated centres, and the system expected to go live in the next few months.

facts.fact: Under its May 2024 contract with the DGSN, Augentic is required to produce refugee cards among other identity documents, according to Biometric Update.
